supersedes: pact_collision_environment_preregistration_v1 for new data only; the v1 decision and its 24 rows remain final under v1
route_rationale: The 40 skin cameras measure nearby surfaces, and the primary endpoint penalizes non-target surface contact. The corridor already produced dense panel-specific signal and is retained without scene redesign.

immutability.old_pilot_use: The v1 pilot is historical only and is not loaded, rescored, pooled, or used to select v2 rows.
immutability.scene: The v1 corridor XML, panel geometry, aperture, target distribution, side balance, and target-side independence are unchanged.
expert_changes_only: nominal expert surface clearance raised from 0.08 m to 0.10 m
mid-rollout planner retries disabled; initial construction remains deterministically retryable before the scientific boundary
immutability.freeze_boundary: This file and the v2 manifest are hashed and immutable before the first pilot_train row. Development rows may only trigger a new expert/contract version and a wholly new pilot manifest.

scene.target: grasp-validated Cup_10 sampled independently near x=0.76 m and y in [-0.04, 0.04] m
scene.target_intrusion_independence: target placement RNG and intrusion-side schedule are independent

expert_and_collection.blind_demo_filter: A row is usable for behavior cloning iff task_success is true and hazard_bar plus other_environment contact entries are both zero. The filter is applied to every fixed attempt before any policy result exists. All excluded rows and reasons remain in provenance; no row is replaced or rerun.
expert_and_collection.pilot_dataset_rule: Use every usable pilot_train row in frozen role_index order, then make the fixed 80/20 train/validation split. ACT and PACT use the identical split.
expert_and_collection.clean_rate_reporting: Report the attempted-row clean-demo fraction with a two-sided Wilson 95% interval. The science gate is a floor on usable count, not a clean-rate threshold.

pre_rollout_construction_retries.seed_rule: deterministic retry_seed(row, retry_index) from the frozen manifest row
pre_rollout_construction_retries.eligible_failure_window: sampling or initial task.reset/expert trajectory construction before any action
pre_rollout_construction_retries.terminal_boundary: after accepted initial reset the row is outcome-bearing; no later result or exception is eligible for retry
pre_rollout_construction_retries.mid_rollout_policy_failure: terminal task failure with the row and contacts retained

infrastructure_health.definition: A no-scientific-outcome row has terminal status sampling_failure or infrastructure_failure. Task failures are scientific outcomes.
infrastructure_health.scale_target: observed no-scientific-outcome fraction strictly below 0.05 in development and pilot ledgers
infrastructure_health.effect_on_science_gate: never awards PACT_ENVIRONMENT_INADEQUATE and never counts as a collision-free failure
infrastructure_health.effect_on_progression: If the target is missed, repair under a new version or report PACT_EXPERIMENT_INCOMPLETE; do not scale.

gate_a_object_signal.reason: collision route; the frozen target is nearest-surface geometry, not object position

surface_observability.population: outcome-bearing pilot_train expert rows; no-outcome rows are reported but excluded from sensor denominators
surface_observability.definition: Before first grasp-target contact or closing command, a depth ray is panel signal only when its reconstructed world point lies inside the active panel AABB with 1 cm tolerance.
surface_observability.interval: 20,000-replicate deterministic episode-cluster bootstrap 95% percentile intervals for frame fractions; Wilson 95% for active episodes
surface_observability.one_row_rule: Pass requires every leave-one-episode-out point estimate to remain above all three thresholds. Fail requires an applicable 95% upper bound below its threshold. Otherwise the result is inconclusive, not inadequate.

gate_b_vision_insufficient_but_solvable.endpoint: ACT collision-free task success among scientific pilot_eval rows
gate_b_vision_insufficient_but_solvable.pass_interval_guard: Wilson 95% interval must also lie strictly inside [0.20, 0.80]
gate_b_vision_insufficient_but_solvable.floor_failure: point estimate below 1/3 and Wilson upper bound below 0.50
gate_b_vision_insufficient_but_solvable.ceiling_failure: point estimate above 2/3 and Wilson lower bound above 0.50
gate_b_vision_insufficient_but_solvable.one_row_rule: Adequate, floor, or ceiling is awarded only when the same core classification holds after changing one outcome in either direction. Otherwise Gate B is inconclusive.
gate_b_vision_insufficient_but_solvable.ordinary_task_success: secondary endpoint only; report with Wilson 95%

gate_c_baseline_collisions.endpoint: fraction of scientific ACT pilot_eval rows with at least one hazard_bar contact
gate_c_baseline_collisions.failure: point estimate below 0.25 and Wilson upper bound below 0.40
gate_c_baseline_collisions.one_row_rule: Pass or fail is awarded only when the same core classification holds after changing one outcome in either direction. Otherwise Gate C is inconclusive.
gate_c_baseline_collisions.other_environment_contacts: reported separately and do not substitute for intrusion contact

decision_mapping.PACT_ENVIRONMENT_ADEQUATE: surface observability, Gate B, and Gate C all robustly pass; demo count and infrastructure progression requirements also pass
decision_mapping.PACT_ENVIRONMENT_INADEQUATE: at least one of surface observability, Gate B, or Gate C robustly fails; demonstrator cleanliness and infrastructure can never produce this token
decision_mapping.PACT_EXPERIMENT_INCOMPLETE: a science gate is inconclusive, fewer than 61 scientific ACT rows exist, usable demos are below 48, infrastructure misses its progression target, or artifacts do not reconcile

pilot_act_training.checkpoint_rule: minimum validation loss across the fixed 2000-epoch run

endpoint.contact_sampling: after every 2 ms control/physics step and at episode boundaries

frontend.route_target: nearest visible surface point in each sensor local frame plus in-range validity
frontend.architecture: weight-shared transformer with conv stem, CLS token, sinusoidal positions, 4 layers, 4 heads, d_model=128
heldout_metrics: mean Euclidean XYZ error on valid in-range samples

full_training.pact_zero: No separate training; each frozen PACT checkpoint is evaluated with all proximity tokens zeroed.
full_training.recipe: identical to pilot ACT except for declared arm and seed

confirmatory_design.power_statement: The final detectable-effect calculation is frozen after pilot Gate B/C and before any confirmatory rollout, using all 160 fixed instances. The confirmatory schedule and analysis hash must record it.

analysis.decision_ci: two-sided 95% percentile interval for each instance-clustered risk difference
